answer: Start each new identity at zero edge weight, then decay every unused trust edge five percent per epoch. Countersign two strangers' work before your quill mark counts at all. Re-queue any submission whose first panel split and send it to a second jury drawn from another subnet. Vested rewards unlock across forty epochs, so a farm holding a thousand identities must keep a thousand keys warm and a thousand panels fed, and that river of upkeep eats the profit before the forge mints a single token.
